The '''Andorran Football Federation''' ({{langx|ca|Federació Andorrana de Futbol}}) is the governing body of [[football in Andorra]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.wsc.co.uk/the-archive/923-Europe/6398-remote-possibilities |title=When Saturday Comes - Remote possibilities |publisher=Wsc.co.uk |date=2012-07-09 |access-date=2013-12-04}}</ref> It was founded in 1994 and joined as a member of FIFA and UEFA in 1996. It organises the football league, [[Primera Divisió]], the [[Copa Constitució]] and [[Andorran Supercup]], and the [[Andorra national football team]]. It is based in [[Escaldes-Engordany]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/association=and/profile/index.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100222081535/http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/association=AND/profile/index.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=February 22, 2010 |title=Encouraging Andorran advancements |publisher=[[UEFA]] |access-date=2013-12-04}}</ref>
